heroes.name: Xal'atath
notes: Shadow Mark [Q]: Void Orb speed slightly increased.
Void Step [E]: Targeting range reduced from 5 to 2. Distance between teleport points reduced from 7 to 6.5. Now prevented and interrupted by Immobilize.
Void Volley [Trait]: Base damage per missile reduced from 90 to 72. Now generates 1 charge for every Basic Attack against enemy Heroes and every 2 Basic Attacks against non-Heroes.
Void Eruption [R]: Uncharged damage reduced by 20%. Fully charged damage reduced by 5%.
Anchored Core (Level 1): Radius bonus reduced from 50% to 25%.
Dark Barrier (Level 4): Now only triggers when enemy Heroes are hit.
Silence of the Lamb (Level 7): Silence duration increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.
Dark Heart's Protection (Level 13): Detonating the Dark Heart on a target affected by Shadow Mark now Silences all enemies hit. Previously Silenced on cast.
Rift Invasion (Level 20): Portals now have non-lethal Health decay, stopping at 4 Health.

general: Fixed an issue where certain Maskless skins were not appearing in the game.

heroes.name: Xal'atath
notes: Orbiting orbs now pause during Time Stop and resume afterward.
Fixed issues that prevented orbiting orbs from correctly following the missile or continuing to orbit after a release queued during Time Stop.
Fixed an issue where Xal'atath was appearing brighter than intended in the game.
Void Volley: fixed an issue that caused impact visual effects to appear at the cursor location instead of where missiles hit.
Void Volley: fixed an issue that prevented the charge indicator from immediately displaying 1 charge upon reaching the second milestone.

Void Eruption: can now be queued to cast or release during Time Stop. Casting enters targeting immediately and charging begins when Time Stop ends; releasing queues the release and greys out the Ability button.
Void Eruption: issuing another Ability, movement, or attack order during Time Stop cancels the pending cast or queued release. Casting it again during Time Stop clears earlier queued orders.
Void Eruption: fixed issues that could allow an additional charge to begin while already charging or during Void Step.
Void Eruption: orb growth and the flight damage timer now pause while Xal'atath is affected by Time Stop.
